title: A refused, timed-out or failed anti-rug escape is never retried by the detector: nothing records the unsafe verdict, re-triggering needs a new LP log, and the poll timer the escape cleared comes back only on some failure paths

evidence.note: confirmBlocks 0: triggerAntiRugExit is awaited and its boolean discarded
confirmBlocks > 0: same, the result is discarded; no pending-rug state is kept anywhere in the module
the gate removes its block handler before it re-evaluates; one gate is one attempt
a re-evaluation RPC error aborts the dispatch; the log calls it fail-closed but it means no exit and no alert
an RPC error while evaluating the triggering log returns verdict unknown with only log.error (V3 the same at :2078-2091); no retry, no alert
comment: the position "retries on a later poll/anti-rug cycle"; no anti-rug cycle exists, dispatch is log-driven only (:1341), plus backfill (:1007) and the gate and grace watchers
every timer of the token is cleared before executeFullSell
a sell-lock refusal returns false without keepMonitoringFailedHeld, so this path never re-arms the timer
the re-arm exists only inside keepMonitoringFailedHeld (failed or still-held exits that reach it)
a detached partial sell holding the lock ends (return true :1584, false :1588) without re-arming the poll interval anti-rug cleared
a budget overrun frees the caller and counts as failure; the underlying executeFullSell keeps running and decides the re-arm on its own later

the private escalation holds the wallet nonce lock for the whole ladder, so an anti-rug exit of another token waits there and can overrun its 60 s budget (RC-11 sibling owned by the TX slice; AUD-EXIT-014)

sibling_sites_checked: Every way a dispatch can end without a sell: sell-lock refusal (exitEngine.ts:832), routine-pause check (bypassed for anti-rug, :824), budget overrun (exitTrigger.ts:263-296), executeFullSell returning false on its own paths (AUD-EXIT-007), confirm re-read error (detector.ts:1871), evaluator error (:1991, :2078), circuit breaker (exitTrigger.ts:221) and dry-run (:179). Every way a dispatch can recur: a new matching log on the pair or pool (dispatchEvent :1341), a backfill replay (:1007, AUD-ANTIRUG-005), the V3 grace timeout (:2123-2141, once per Burn). No other trigger exists in the slice.
severity_rationale: S1, confirmed by code reading; this also confirms the mechanism AUD-EXIT-014 left as a candidate (that entry is EXIT-owned; its status is for the 22-28 consolidation to update). Plausible conditions: a rug that starts while another exit of the token is in flight (stop-loss firing on the first dumps), a 60 s budget overrun behind the wallet nonce lock, or one RPC error during the evaluation or the confirm re-read. The emergency exit is then lost, and in the partial-sell case the routine exit too.

sub_claims.claim: (1) Answer to the AUD-EXIT-014 open question (22-18): a refused or timed-out rug escape does NOT fire again by design. It recurs only when (a) a new Burn, Transfer or Collect log arrives on the same pair or pool and evaluates unsafe, or (b) a backfill replay (AUD-ANTIRUG-005) happens to re-cover the original rug logs, which needs a WS reconnect or any new registration on the chain with a gap within maxBackfillBlocks. After a completed rug there are usually no further LP logs, so in practice the escape is lost.

(2) If the sell lock was held by a detached partial sell when anti-rug fired, nothing re-arms the poll interval anti-rug cleared; the position stays held with anti-rug registered but no stop-loss, trailing or urgency exit (the AUD-EXIT-007 shape).
(3) Each refused or timed-out attempt still counts against the circuit breaker.

recommendation: Keep per-position anti-rug state: an unsafe verdict stays pending until a successful exit or a genuine close, and a refused, aborted or failed escape is retried on the next block (bounded, with the anti-rug parameters) with an alert each time; re-arm the poll timer on every false return after clearing it. Precedence over in-flight exits is card EXIT-11; dedupe and retry are card ANTIRUG-01. Phase 24.
